newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary revises Q1 1996 GDP fall to unchanged.
newsitem.headline: Hungary revises Q1 1996 GDP fall to unchanged.

text.p: Hungary's gross domestic product (GDP) in the first quarter of 1996 was flat from a year ago, reversing an earlier estimate which showed GDP in the period down by one percent, the Central Statistical Office (KSH) said.

"Based on checks and correction of basic information, and on data which arrived with delay, KSH revised the previous estimates and modified the figures," the statement said. "This resulted in a one percentage point change in the GDP (index)."
The KSH did not give quarter-on-quarter comparisons.
